findings.text: follow-on: _clock_for_window returns None for any reported length that is neither 300, 10,080 nor greater than 10,080, so an account reporting, say, a 1,440-minute window is silently dropped by _state_window_reading (budget.py:1747) and its group falls back to a stale receipt instead of pacing by the reported window.

follow-on: the week test's fixture is built at 10,080 minutes, the value the code falls back to when no reported length is treated as operative, so its derived == 0.0733 assertion at line 79 passes under both the corrected and the fixed-week code and guards nothing the month test at line 57 does not already guard.

item_verdicts.goal: 7 asks the codex lane to pace by the quota window the provider reports; reckon/budget.py:1920 _group_allowance derives a primary-only group's allowance as the operative window's elapsed fraction times budget.pace_multiple, and reckon/crew/window_reading.py:59 retains the reported length, so the 43,200-minute fixture at tests/test_budget_window_length.py:57 returns 0.0733 rather than a fixed-week figure.
